scenes.summary: You come across an anomaly while exploring the wilderness. According to Fiona, it is an Energy Alluvium about to go out of control. She asks you to clean it up but also reminds you to be fully prepared before approaching it.

lines.text: Endmin, please clean up this Energy Alluvium quickly.
Well, if we leave this alluvium unchecked, the consequences may spiral out of control.
Try to use the combat facilities that our operators have placed.
They can help you fight off enemies but you can build more to ramp up our advantage.
And while cleaning out the alluvium, you must stand your ground until every enemy is defeated.
If you run into another Energy Alluvium, try to clean it up as well, Endmin.
Careful, Endmin! There's an Energy Alluvium nearby. Luckily, it can still be contained.
Our operators have deployed several combat facilities here as part of their preventive measures. You can activate them when required.
